s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic vision disturbance with signs of intraocular inflammation and macular edema
salient_findings: Cystoid macular edema with subfoveal fluid
Keratic precipitates and cells in the anterior chamber
key_facts: Blurry vision in right eye for several months
Anastrozole therapy for more than 2 years
Conjunctival injection and fine keratic precipitates in right eye
Cystoid macular edema with yellow spot in fovea in right eye
No peripheral inflammation in either eye
Normal blood tests for vasculitis and rheumatologic disorders

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic vision disturbance with signs of intraocular inflammation and macular edema
salient_findings: Cystoid macular edema with subfoveal fluid
Keratic precipitates and cells in the anterior chamber
key_facts: Blurry vision in right eye for several months
Anastrozole therapy for more than 2 years
Conjunctival injection and fine keratic precipitates in right eye
Cystoid macular edema with yellow spot in fovea in right eye
No peripheral inflammation in either eye
Normal blood tests for vasculitis and rheumatologic disorders

shortlist.label: uveitis
shortlist.why_kept: History of bilateral iritis and presence of fine keratic precipitates

shortlist.label: cystoid macular edema
shortlist.why_kept: Significant cystoid macular edema and subfoveal fluid in the right eye on OCT

shortlist.label: sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic vision disturbance with signs of intraocular inflammation

shortlist.label: lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of left-sided mastectomy and anastrozole therapy, potential for secondary lymphoma

shortlist.label: scleritis
shortlist.why_kept: Conjunctival injection and fine keratic precipitates in the right eye, potential for scleral involvement

raw.rationale: History of recurrent bilateral iritis, presence of fine keratic precipitates and cells in the anterior chamber, and cystoid macular edema are consistent with uveitis.

rejected.label: cystoid macular edema
rejected.why: While present, it is a symptom rather than a primary diagnosis.

rejected.label: sarcoidosis
rejected.why: Normal blood tests for vasculitis and rheumatologic disorders make this less likely.

rejected.label: lymphoma
rejected.why: No other indications of lymphoma, such as abnormal imaging or blood tests, are present.

rejected.label: scleritis
rejected.why: Lack of significant ciliary flush and severe pain, which are typical of scleritis, makes this diagnosis less likely.
